description: This file is a shell script used for performance testing of Git tag-following behavior with many tags. It sets up repositories, creates commit histories, creates tags, and performs fetch operations to measure performance impacts.

methods.name: create_history
methods.description: Creates a commit history with specified number of commits and unique files pointing to a specific blob.

methods.name: create_tags
methods.description: Creates a series of tags for the commits in the given revision range.

methods.name: setup_many_packs
methods.description: Sets up multiple pack files in the repository (definition assumed to be in external sourced scripts).
